title: Investors Look Past Romania Risk to Pocket Junk-Like Yields
summary: Traders are treating Romanian bonds as the European Union’s only junk-rated sovereign debt, with the country’s high yields luring investors despite a protracted political crisis in Bucharest.

title: Gold Rises as Traders Weigh Oil Decline Before Key Fed Decision
summary: Gold advanced after a two-day drop, as traders weighed a modest retreat in oil prices against bets on the near-certainty of an interest-rate hike by the Federal Reserve later Wednesday.

title: PBOC Chief Unfazed by Credit Slump as Era of Surging Loans Ends
summary: China’s central bank governor signaled a long period of massive credit growth has come to an end, in what amounted to a message of reassurance for markets after an abrupt deceleration in lending as the economy loses its appetite for borrowing.

title: Glencore Faces $2 Billion Radiant World Claim in Singapore
summary: Glencore has accused Radiant World and associated companies of sending falsified invoices to lenders, cutting ties just as the iron ore trader filed a suit in Singapore against the Swiss-based commodities group, seeking S$2.5 billion ($2 billion) in damages.

title: UniCredit Banker Sees Bigger Rally in Soaring Polish Equities
summary: Poland’s revved-up stocks have further to run as new investors pour cash into eastern Europe’s biggest equity market, according to a senior banker at UniCredit SpA.

title: Vietnam Warns of Blackouts From 2027 as Power Projects Stutter
summary: Vietnam could face electricity shortages from next year as power-generation and grid projects fall behind schedule, according to the country’s trade ministry, putting plans for double-digit economic growth at risk.

title: Europe’s New Stocks Tape Needs to Go Deeper, Industry Groups Say
summary: A long-awaited feed of data on European stocks finally went live this week, but groups representing banks, investors and traders say it doesn’t go far enough.

title: Inflation Data Points to Rate Hike: JPMorgan's Rasid
summary: JPMorgan Global Market Strategist Raisah Rasid tells Paul Allen that incoming economic data and rising Treasury yields point to a Fed rate hike. She urges investors to focus on the 12- to 18-month rate trajectory and the central bank's long-term inflation outlook. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: CATL Shares Drop 10% in Two Days as Outlook Worries Mount

title: Shrinking China Fuel Stockpiles Raise Chance of Export Curbs

title: HSBC, ICICI Propel India Finance Hub With FX Loans for Diaspora
